why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Brandon Valenzuela is slot #3 (4.617 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #2, #1, #6, #5, #7, #4, #8, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #9 ranks 9 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.007 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.46 expected PA/game vs 3.81 at primary slot #9. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
